pages.title: Give up
pages.meaning: to stop trying to do something
examples: Never give up on your dreams.
He gave up smoking last year.

pages.title: Give in
pages.meaning: to finally agree after refusing for a long time
examples: The kids cried until Mom gave in.

pages.title: Give away
pages.meaning: to give something free, or reveal a secret
pages.hindi: muft mein de dena / raaz khol dena
examples: She gave away her old clothes.

pages.title: Give back
pages.meaning: to return something to its owner

pages.title: Give out
pages.meaning: to hand things to many people, or to stop working
examples: The teacher gave out the test papers.
My old phone finally gave out.
